profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | React, Node.js, Python & AI

summary.short: Full-stack engineer with 8+ years in technology, specializing in React, Node.js, Python, and AI-powered systems. Dev Lead at PwC México.
summary.long: Full-stack software engineer with 8+ years of experience in technology, building scalable web, mobile, and AI-powered applications with React, Node.js, Python, and cloud infrastructure. Currently a Dev Lead at PwC México, leading development teams, architecting production systems, and delivering blockchain and data engineering solutions for enterprise clients. Track record of measurable impact, including cutting daily inventory processing time by 88% through workflow automation.

responsibilities: Lead end-to-end full-stack delivery across a React microservices frontend, Node.js and Python backend services, and PySpark data pipelines
Drive vulnerability remediation through software composition analysis scanning, reducing security risk and keeping services compliant
Own release documentation and feature promotion workflows, improving deployment reliability across services
Integrate AI agent-assisted development workflows into the team's daily practice, accelerating feature delivery, debugging, and maintenance
Define commit standards and repository management practices to keep codebases clean and auditable
Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and development planning
Work directly with technical and business stakeholders to align engineering priorities with product goals
Built scalable web platforms integrated with blockchain-based data pipelines for enterprise clients
Designed secure data engineering workflows with Python and Databricks, processing on-chain and off-chain datasets through custom ETL and analytics pipelines
Developed AI-powered applications using LLM integrations and agent-based workflows with tools such as Cursor and Claude Code
Created React interfaces for blockchain data visualization and enterprise reporting
Built a full-stack inventory management platform with real-time stock synchronization and order processing
Automated bulk inventory intake through Excel import workflows, replacing manual data entry
Developed the React and TypeScript frontend alongside Node.js/Express REST APIs
Deployed and operated production infrastructure on DigitalOcean using PM2 and Nginx
Led development of SIAN, a tire fleet inspection and management application for Android built with React Native
Integrated Bluetooth scanner hardware through native modules for real-time inspection data capture
Improved mobile application performance and user experience using React Native native modules
Delivered a cross-platform inventory management system spanning web (React) and mobile (React Native) applications
Automated goods-receiving and inventory workflows, cutting daily manual processing time by 88% (from 2 hours to 15 minutes)
Built authenticated, performance-optimized React and React Native applications
Designed Node.js/Express APIs that unified goods receiving and inventory management into a single system
Architected a GPS fleet-tracking platform for real-time vehicle monitoring
Built Node.js/Express backend services on MySQL with Google Maps integration for live geospatial visualization
Implemented secure authentication workflows using Passport.js
Delivered responsive tracking dashboards used for daily fleet operations
Built a server-side rendered web application to digitize the optical center's operational data management
Developed Node.js/Express backend services with Passport.js authentication
Created responsive interfaces using Handlebars, CSS, and Bootstrap
Maintained industrial electromechanical systems and production equipment in a high-volume manufacturing plant
Earned certifications in power transmission, equipment alignment, and SKF sealing systems through Nestlé's technical training program in automation, control systems, maintenance, and welding
Developed an e-commerce platform using HAML, SASS, Bootstrap, jQuery, and JavaScript
Enabled online product browsing and direct customer communication through the website
